assumptions: NPC Runtime supplies authoritative death ordering, room identity, corpse timing, and any loot reservation.
Classic NPC drop flags and loot-table relationships remain unproven and are not auto-projected.
safe_fallback: Transfer ordinary NPC-owned roots while retaining only items with explicit npc_no_drop or no_loot metadata; reject missing identities and invalid loot windows without mutation.
runtime_impact: NPC-owned inventory and equipment can transition into a persistent corpse while preserving portable-container subtrees and explicit no-drop items.
character_save_impact: None until a character loots the corpse.
world_state_impact: Creates corpse state and transfers eligible NPC item instances into world-owned corpse state.
